name: Ultimo S
short_description:
Red dry wine (alc. 14.0%, vintage 2020 SYRAH 100% )

Ruby red wine of medium intensity without sediment. On the nose, very pleasant aromas of red fresh fruits such as cherry, pomegranate and cranberry, black pepper, and florals such as rose petals and hibiscus with a slight influence of oak. A wine of medium plus body, very rounded and elegant with a nice expression of ripe cherry, pomegranate, juicy red currant and wild blueberry with nice earthy tones like fresh boletus, spicy carnation like filich and black telicheri pepper with a touch of fresh beets and dried Mediterranean herbs with a long aftertaste. The wine is in excellent harmony between varietal spicy-floral aromas that did not go to the rustic extreme, the unpretentious influence of the wood in which the wine was aged is also noticeable, and a very stable structure in the form of excellent acids, calm soft tannins and tamed alcohol. A wine with solid aging potential that is just at the beginning of its journey and completely in its own style leaning towards the northern Rhône, faithfully reflecting the full opulence and capacity of this great spice variety!

Position: Principovac

Aging: 20 months in barrique 225

Gastronomic recommendation : It is ideal with lamb chops with fresh thyme and rosemary, roast duck with cherry or orange sauce, as well as with game – especially venison in red wine sauce with mushrooms, veal ragout with aromatic herbs. Also with porcini mushroom risotto, as well as roasted beets with goat cheese and walnuts. Cheese lovers can pair it with mature hard cheeses like Pecorino, Manchego or Comté.

Recommended serving temperature: 14-16°C

name: ToCa 2018
short_description:
Red dry wine (alc. 14.0%, vintage 2018 vintage Bordeaux blend CABERNET SAUVIGNON 85% and MERLOT 15%)

Ruby red color with low intensity, which is consistent with the aged wine from 2018. Medium mobility with a thick colored ring. The wine was aged for 12 months in a Serbian barrique of 225 liters. The smell of a high attack of aromas dominated by the sumptuous aromas of red and black fresh and jammy fruits. Aronia, cranberry, pomegranate, sour cherry, rosehip jam with plenty of herbs, coffee, roasted orange peel and cedar wood are just some of the sophisticated attributes of our Bordeaux blend. Alcohol mildly acceptable dominant in the balance of olfactory performance. The taste is fruity with plenty of red fresh fruit and secondary notes of harmoniously toasted oak. Sour cherry, cherry, pomegranate, eucalyptus, rose… with shiny carob and almonds from Serbian oak. Full body, smooth slightly prickly texture and long finish. Tannins sweet and polymerized with a touch of cedar and tobacco. A harmonious, integrated and fleshy wine from two grape varieties that adore each other. Cabernet Sauvignon dominates for a reason.

Position: Lug

Aging: 12 months in barrique 225

Gastronomic recommendation: a wine that does not require a bite. Besides himself, he likes stronger, fattier and heavier food. Our recommendation is ready-made game dishes, barbecue and roasting under the stove.

Recommended serving temperature: 14-16°C

name: ToCa 2018
short_description:
Crveno suvo vino (alc. 14,0%, berba 2018. Bordeaux kupaža CABERNET SAUVIGNON 85% i MERLOT 15%)

Boja rubin crvena niskog inteziteta, što je u skladu sa odležalim vinom iz 2018. Srednje pokretljivo sa debelim obojenim prstenom. Vino je 12 meseci odležalo u domaćem bariku od 225 lit.  Miris visokog napada aroma gde dominiraju raskošni mirisi crvenog i crnog svežeg i džemastog voća. Aronija, brusnica, nar, višnja, džem od šipka sa dosta začinskog bilja, kafe, pečene kore pomorandže i kedrovine, samo su deo sofisticiranih atributa naše bordoške kupaže . Alkohol blago prihvatljivo dominantan u balansu olfaktorne performanse. Ukus voćni sa dosta crvenog svežeg voća i sekundarnih nota skladno tostiranog hrasta. Višnja, trešnja, nar, eukaliptus, ruža… sa sjajno i tegrisanim rogačem i bademima od srpskog hrasta. Punog tela, glatke blago bockave teksture i duge završnice. Tanini slatki i polimerizovani sa dodirom kedrovine i duvana. Skladno, integrisano i mesnato vino od dve sorte vinove loze koje se međusobno obožavaju. Cabernet sauvignon sa razlogom dominira.

Pozicija : Lug

Odležavanje : 12 meseci u bariku 225

Gastronomska preporuka : vino kome zalogaj nije neophodan. Pored sebe voli jaču, masniju i težu hranu. Naša preporuka gotova jela od divljači, roštilj i pečenja ispod sača.

Preporučena temperatura serviranja : 14 – 16°C

name: Ultimo S
short_description:
Ovo vino dolazi iz vinograda na Fruškoj gori, gde kombinacija zemljišta, klime i dugogodišnjeg iskustva daje prepoznatljiv karakter svakoj boci.

Crveno suvo vino (alc. 14,0%, berba 2020. SYRAH 100% )

Vino rubin crvene boje srednjeg inteziteta bez sedimenta. Na nosu vrlo prijatne arome crvenog svežeg voća poput višnje, nara i brusnice, crnog bibera, te floralnih poput latica ruža i hibiskusa sa blagim uticajem hrasta.Vino srednjeg plus tela, veoma zaokruženo i elegantno sa lepom ekspresijom zrele višnje, nara, sočne crvene ribizle i divlje borovnice sa lepim zemljanim tonovima poput svežih vrganja, začinskim poput karanfilića kao i crnog teličeri bibera sa dodirom sveže cvekle i sušenog začinskog mediteranskog bilja sa dugim after tejstom. Vino je u odličnoj harmoniji izmedju sortnih začinsko-floralnih aroma koje nisu otišle u rustičnu krajnost, primetan je i nepretenciozni uticaj drveta u kojem je vino odležavalo, te vrlo stabilna struktura u vidu odličnih kiselina, smirenih mekanih tanina i ukroćenih alkohola. Vino solidnog potencijala za odležavanje koje je tek na početku svog puta i u potpuno svom stilu koje naginje ka severnoj Roni, koja verno odslikava pun raskoš i kapacitet ove sjajne začinske sorte!

Pozicija : Principovac

Odležavanje : 20 meseci u bariku 225

Gastronomska preporuka : Idealno je uz jagnjeće kotlete sa svežim timijanom i ruzmarinom, pečenu patku sa sosom od višanja ili narandže, kao i uz divljač – posebno srnetinu u umaku od crnog vina sa pečurkama, teleći ragu sa aromatičnim biljem. Takođe sa rižotom od vrganja, kao i sa pečenim cveklama sa kozjim sirom i orasima. Ljubitelji sireva mogu ga upariti sa zrelim tvrdim sirevima poput Pecorina, Manchega ili Comté.

Preporučena temperatura serviranja : 14 – 16°C

name: Trigio Rouge
short_description:
Red dry wine (alc 13.5%, vintage 2020 blend Syrah – Merlot – Cabernet Sauvignon)

Pleasant ripe cherry red color of medium intensity. On the aroma of dominant fermentative secondary aromas of cherry liqueur, plum jam with a very precise influence of black pepper and toasted vanilla from barrel aging.

Full-bodied, sublime and rich taste. Sumptuous spices and dried apricot dominate the bouquet.

Red and black fruits narrowly round out the palate. Intense influence of premium oak with young and velvety tannins. A wine with aging potential. It needs to be decanted.

Gastronomic recommendation: Ready-made dishes of red meat and game, lamb and veal with baked potatoes.

It is served at a temperature of: 14 – 16°C

name: Trigio Rouge
short_description:
Crveno suvo vino (alk 13,5%, berba 2020. kupaža Syrah – Merlot – Cabernet sauvignon)
Dopadljive zrela višnja crvene boje srednjeg inteziteta. Na mirisu dominantne fermentativne sekundarne arome likera od višnje, džema od šljiva sa vrlo preciznim uticajem crnog bibera i tostirane vanile od odležavanja u bariku.
Punog tela, uzvišenog i bogatog ukusa. Raskošni začini i sušena marelica dominiraju na bukeu.
Crveno i crno voće skučeno zaokružuju nepce. Intezivan uticaj vrhunskog hrasta sa mladim i somotastim taninima. Vino sa potencijalom odležavanja. Potrebno ga je dekantirati.
Gastro preporuka: Gotova jela od crvenog mesa i divljači, jagnjetina i teletina ispod sača sa pekarskim krompirom.
Servira se na temperaturi: 14 – 16°C

name: Trigio Blanc
short_description:
White dry wine (alc 13.0%, vintage 2024 blend Tamjanika – Grašac – Pinot grigio)

Bright straw yellow color with a starry glow.

Smell of medium aroma intensity. Parallel varietal genre of seasonal green vegetables with discreet notes of green apple and home pear. Pinot grigio indirectly and transparently follows the dominant Grašac.

The taste is creamy, honeyed and juicy. Medium-bodied on the palate with a pleasant taste of dried fruit and yellow flowers. The long freshness of lemon and grapefruit gives it a magical characteristic.

Gastronomic recommendation: Trigio Blanc with sea and river fish and intense toppings and spices, fatty red meat from the grill, as well as semi-fatty and fatty white and blue cheeses.

It is served at a temperature of: 9 – 11°C

name: LEX premium rose
short_description:
Rose wine (13.5% alc, vintage 2023)

Moderately colored, light pink in color, this wine confirms expectations with its aroma, bringing elegance and complexity. An abundance of red fruit awaits you in the glass, from raspberry to strawberry, followed by pomegranate, fresh watermelon, then some red grapefruit and a nice, tickling spicy touch in the background. Structured and supple, with a backbone of firm but tamed acids and an intriguing herbal-citrus finish.

Position: Babinac

Gastronomy recommendation: It goes perfectly with salmon tartare, but also nigiri sushi with salmon, and even with Philadephia rolls. As a first choice, there are cocktail gambori, fresh grilled shrimp, mussels in a tomato sauce or fresh pasta with seafood. This wine is also an excellent match for light meats, such as chicken prepared with Provençal spices or roast rabbit.

Recommended serving temperature: 9-11 °C

name: LEX premium rose
short_description:
Rose vino (13,5% alk, berba 2023.)

Umereno obojen, svetlo roze boje, ovo vino svojim mirisom potvrđuje očekivanja donoseći eleganciju i kompleksnost. U čaši vas čeka obilje crvenog voća, od maline do jagode, a slede nar, sveža lubenica, zatim malo crvenog grejpa i fini, golicavi začinski štih u pozadini. Struktuirano i gipko, sa kičmom čvrstih, ali ukroćenih kiselina i intrigantnom herbalno – citrusnom završnicom.

Položaj: Babinac

Gastro preporuka: Savršeno ide uz tartar od losos, ali i nigiri suši sa lososom, pa čak i uz Philadephia rolls. Kao prvi izbor tu su i koktel gambori, sveži škampi sa roštilja, dagnje u buzari sa paradajzom ili sveže paste sa plodovima mora. Ovakvo vino odličan je par i za lagana mesa, poput piletine pripremljene sa provansalskim začinima ili špikovanog kunića.

Preporučena temperatura serviranja: 9-11 °C

name: Optimus
short_description:
White dry wine (alc 13.0%, vintage 2024. GRAŠAC 100%)

Fresh, lemony, perfectly balanced, crisp acids and a long finish

Gastronomic recommendation: grilled perch, pie with greens, grilled goat cheese on arugula with sun-dried tomato pesto, pasta with chicken and spinach in cream sauce.

It is served at a temperature of: 9 – 11°C

name: Trigio Blanc
short_description:
Belo suvo vino (alk 13,0%, berba 2024. kupaža Tamjanika – Grašac – Pinot grigio)
Svetle slamenožute boje sa zvezdanim odsjajem.
Miris srednjeg inteziteta aroma. Paralela sortnog žanra sezonskog zelenog povrća sa diskretnim notama zelene jabuke i domaće kruške. Pinot grigio posredno i transparentno prati dominantni Grašac.
Na ukusu kremasto, medno i sočno. Srednjeg tela na nepcu sa prijatnom ukusnošcu sušenog voća i žutog cveća. Duga svežina limuna i grejpa daje čarobnu karakteristiku.
Gastro preporuka: Trigio Blanc sa morskom i rečnom ribom i intezivnim prelivima i začinima, masna crvena mesa sa roštilja, kao i polumasni i masni beli i plavi sirevi.
Servira se na temperaturi: 9 – 11°C

name: Pinot Grigio
short_description:
White dry wine (14.0% alc, 2024)

The wine is yellow in color with a greenish tint. The scent is fruity with notes of pear, apple, peach, enriched with gentle tones of lemon grass and flowers. The taste is full, smooth and very drinkable with a pleasant fruity mineral finish.

Gastronomic recommendation: Grilled white meat, pear and young goat’s cheese, white meat dishes, light salads, white cheeses, river fish

It is served at a temperature of: 9 – 11°C

name: Pinot Grigio
short_description:
Pinot Grigio je idealan za ljubitelje belih vina koji traže balans između voćnosti, strukture i elegancije. Pogodno za posebne prilike, ali i svakodnevno uživanje.

Belo suvo vino (14,0% alk, 2024.)

Vino je žute boje sa zelenkastim odsjajem. Miris je voćan sa notama kruške, jabuke, breskve, obogaćen nežnim tonovima limun trave i cveća. Na ukusu je pun, gladak i veoma pitak sa prijatnom voćno mineralnom završnicom.

Gastro preporuka: Grilovano belo meso, kruška i mlad koziji sir, jela od belog mesa, lake obrok salate, beli sirevi, rečna riba

Servira se na temperaturi: 9 – 11°C

name: Sauvignon Blanc Barrique
short_description:
White wine (14.0% alc, vintage 2018)

Characteristic white wine, complex and refined white sauvignon aged in wood. It is characterized by a moderately intense scent of ripe nectarine, lemon and baked leather apple, with fine floral tones of chamomile and honey. Finely balanced wine, very juicy, but with backbone and preserved freshness. The taste is persistent, and yellow fruit, citrus, vanilla and gentle notes of freshly cut grass are intertwined.

Position: Lug

Aging: 12 months in barrique.

Gastronomic recommendation: pasta with fresh pesto sauce, grilled sea bream, cod fillet, perch in creamy sauce, risotto with asparagus, peas with chicken

Recommended serving temperature: 9-11°C

name: Sauvignon Blanc Barrique
short_description:
Belo vino (14,0% alk, berba 2018.)

Karakterno belo vino, kompleksni i prefinjeni beli sovinjon odležao u drvetu. Odlikuje ga umereno intenzivan miris zrele nektarine, limuna i pečene jabuke kožare, sa finim cvetnim tonovima kamilice i meda. Fino izbalansirano vino, veoma sočno, ali sa kičmom i očuvanom svežinom. Ukus je postojan, a i njemu se prepliću žuto voće, citrusi, vanila i nežne note sveže pokošene trave.

Položaj: Lug

Odležavanje: 12 meseci u bariku.

Gastro preporuka: testenina sa svežim pesto sosom, grilovana orada, file bakalara, smuđ u kremastom sosu, rižoto sa šparglama, grašak sa piletinom

Preporučena temperatura serviranja: 9-11°C

name: Chardonnay Barrique
short_description:
Ako tražite kvalitetno domaće vino iz Srbije, Chardonnay Barrique vinarije Trivanović predstavlja odličan izbor zahvaljujući sopstvenim vinogradima i kontrolisanoj proizvodnji.

Belo vino (14,0% alk, berba 2020.)

Chardonnay Barrique na ukusu daje suve smokve i prijatnu aromu vanile sa dodirom hrasta, skladne kiseline i dugotrajne puteraste završnice.

Položaj: Lug

Odležavanje: 12 meseci u bariku.

Gastro preporuka: Vrganji ili tartufi sa pršutom na puteru sjedinjeni sa omiljenom testeninom.

Preporučena temperatura serviranja: 10-12 C°C

name: Chardonnay Barrique
short_description:
White wine (14.0% alc, vintage 2020)

On the palate, dried figs and a pleasant aroma of vanilla with a touch of oak, harmonious acidity and a long-lasting buttery finish.

Position: Lug

Aging: 12 months in barrique.

Gastronomic recommendation: Boletus or truffles with prosciutto in butter combined with your favorite pasta.

Recommended serving temperature: 10-12 C°C

name: Shiraz
short_description:
Red dry wine (13.0% alc, 2019)

Ruby red color with violet tones, on the scent wild strawberry, black currant and dogwood interpenetrate each other. The taste of cocoa, raspberry and Amarena cherry in a fantastic combination.

Gastronomic recommendation: grilled marinated pork neck in pomegranate sauce or lamb chops with blueberry sauce and grilled polenta with bacon.

It is served at a temperature of: 14 – 16°C

name: Shiraz
short_description:
Crveno suvo vino (13,0% alk, 2019.)

Rubin crvene boje sa ljubičastim tonovima, na mirisu se međusobno prožimaju šumska jagoda, crna ribizla i drenjina. Na ukusu kakao, malina i višnja Amarena u fantastičnom spoju.

Gastro preporuka: marinirani svinjski vrat na grilu u sosu od nara ili jagnjeći kotleti sa sosom od borovnice i grilovanom palentom sa slaninom.

Servira se na temperaturi: 14 – 16°C

name: Optimus
short_description:
Belo suvo vino (alc 13,0%, berba 2024. GRAŠAC 100%)

Sveže, limunaste, savršeno izbalansirane, oštre kiseline i dugog završetka

Gastronomska preporuka: smuđ na žaru, pita sa zeljem, grilovani kozji sir na rukoli sa pestom od sušenog paradajza, testenina sa piletinom i spanaćem u krem sosu.

Servira se na temperaturi od: 9 – 11°C
